desc: Parse `K`, `S`, and `T`, and reject immediately when `abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K`.
Implement banded Levenshtein DP with rolling arrays, considering only states whose index difference is at most `K`.
Initialize boundary states correctly for insertions and deletions, using a large sentinel value outside the band.
For each pair of positions in the band, compute the minimum of deletion, insertion, and match/replacement transitions.
Check the final DP value against `K` and print `Yes` or `No`.
